thread:
alice (support): FYI customer ACME hit 429s — monthly credits dropped to 0 about ~03:05 PDT, ~3 hours before they expected the monthly refill. They say no plan change. Repro steps and logs below.

acme-admin: we migrated projects from org-old -> org-new yesterday (finalized ~01:20 PDT). Heavy embedding stream around 02:45-03:00. UI showed 0 credits at 03:05, API returned 429s. Request ids: req_01H123, req_01H124. Account timezone: America/Los_Angeles.

alice (support): thanks — can you confirm account id and share the exact timestamps for the 429s? did you perform any billing/account changes during migration?

acme-admin: tenant_id=acme-123, 429s at 03:05:12 and 03:06:40 PDT. No plan tier changes. Only org/seat migration.

sam (infra): pulling logs — I see a cache invalidation event for tenant=acme-123 at 03:02:08 PDT coming from the org-migration job. Possible race: migration changed tenant->quota mapping before the monthly replenish job ran, so quota tokens credited to old mapping. Looking at scheduler we also had a replenish window around 03:00-03:10 for a subset of tenants that are anchored to non-midnight UTC.

josh (eng-sre): to confirm, refill timing is per-account billing anchor (UTC-based) not tenant local midnight, correct? if the migration moved the tenant to a different org that has a different billing anchor we could see an apparent early depletion. I'll fetch the replenish logs for tenant acme-123.

priya (billing): billing shows no plan change. Account creation anchor: 2023-11-07T14:30:00Z -> monthly replenishes at 14:30:00Z. That equals 07:30 PST (08:30 PDT). Customer expecting 06:00 PDT suggests a mismatch in their expectation vs actual anchor.

alice (support): useful context — customer believed we reset at local midnight. Important to check two things: 1) whether replenish ran and credited tokens to the correct quota shard; 2) whether migration invalidated the shard mapping and moved credits to an unreachable bucket. Sam can you show the scheduler response for acme-123?

sam (infra): ran internal admin query. snippet:
```
GET /internal/admin/tenants/acme-123/credit_state
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-123",
  "account_anchor": "2026-03-01T14:30:00Z",
  "last_replenish": "2026-02-01T14:30:00Z",
  "pending_migration": true,
  "last_migration_ts": "2026-03-01T01:20:00Z",
  "cache_invalidate_ts": "2026-03-01T03:02:08Z"
}
```
This shows migration finalization at 01:20 and a cache invalidation at 03:02. The replenish job scheduled for this tenant ran at 14:30Z (07:30 PDT) — which is later than the time customer expected. However, I also see a partial replenish attempt for legacy mapping that executed around 03:00Z for a different shard; credits may have been routed to the old mapping and not the live tenant record.

alice (support): action: run manual replenish against the live tenant record and confirm API recovery. If that fixes it, we'll escalate infra to add a post-migration replenish or migration ordering guard.

sam (infra): manual replenish executed at 03:20 PDT — API checks after that show requests succeeding, no 429s for the subsequent 40m. Logged manual op id MANREF-778.

acme-admin: confirmed — after the manual refill our streaming job resumed and errors stopped. Thanks. Any short-term mitigation so we don't hit the same mid-night confusion?

josh (eng-sre): root cause summary: migration created a short window where the tenant->quota mapping pointed to an old shard while the scheduled replenish/retry logic credited a different mapping. Two fixes: (1) ensure migration finalization waits for active replenish retry window to finish or triggers an immediate replenish post-migration; (2) add a safety reconciliation that backfills credits if cache_invalidate and last_replenish mismatch is detected. I'll open INF-5821 for the infra fix.

priya (billing): billing side: will also add note to customer-facing docs clarifying that monthly refill is anchored to account creation time (UTC) not local midnight — and that migrations can shift effective timing if org-level anchors differ.

alice (support): created support case SUP-10234, attached manual replenish logs and customer repro steps. Marking resolved for now but will follow up once INF-5821 has progress. :white_check_mark:

acme-admin: appreciated — please include a small runbook we can reference before future migrations.

alice (support): will do — adding runbook item: "Before finalizing org/tenant migrations, run 'admin check-replenish-state <tenant>' and schedule manual replenish if last_replenish < last_migration_ts or if cache_invalidate within 10m of migration."
notes: thread documents should be short; this one includes technical snippets and an action list.
